WITH award_counts AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.throws, ''), '') AS throwing_hand,
           COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM player_award AS pa
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.throws, ''), '')
),
hand_shares AS (
    SELECT throwing_hand,
           award_count,
           1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM award_counts
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM hand_shares
)
SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;
